subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT among the groups organised by microfinance institutions in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Urban Model Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Urban Model Bank is not a recognized model within microfinance institutions in India.
 
• Microfinance institutions primarily focus on rural and semi-urban areas to provide financial services to the underserved population.
 
• Urban Model Banks are not typically associated with microfinance activities aimed at low-income groups.
 
• Microfinance models like Self Help Groups (SHGs) and Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) are more prevalent for financial inclusion in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Grameen Model Bank:**

 
 
• A microfinance model that originated in Bangladesh and focuses on providing small loans to the poor without requiring collateral.
 
• It promotes financial inclusion and empowers women by forming groups for collective borrowing.
 
 
 
• **Self Help Group (SHG):**
 
 
• A village-based financial intermediary committee usually composed of 10-20 local women or men.
 
• They pool their savings together and use the collective fund to make small loans to group members.
 
 
 
• **Joint Liability Group (JLG):**
 
 
• A microfinance model where a group of individuals come together to jointly receive and repay loans.
 
• It is based on mutual guarantee, which reduces the risk of default and enhances credit access for the poor.
 
 
 
• **Microfinance Institutions (MFIs):**
 
 
• Organizations that provide financial services to low-income individuals or groups who lack access to traditional banking services.
 
• They offer services like microloans, savings, insurance, and remittance to promote financial inclusion.
